# commander_enterprise_scim (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an enterprise **SCIM configuration** by **ID** / **Node ID** or **managed company** (MSP only) so you can reference it from other resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scim` (String) **SCIM configuration ID or Node ID** to look up.

### Optional

- `managed_company` (String) Only applies to **MSP accounts**. **Name** or **ID** of the managed company to scope this resource or data source to. Omit to use the logged-in account context.

### Read-Only

- `node_id` (String) The **node** that manages this SCIM configuration.
- `node_name` (String) The **name** of the node that manages this SCIM configuration.
- `prefix` (String) **Role prefix**. SCIM groups starting with this prefix are imported to Keeper as roles.
- `scim_id` (String) **SCIM configuration ID** to look up.
- `scim_url` (String) The SCIM **endpoint URL** for this configuration.
- `status` (String) **Current status** of the SCIM configuration (for example, `active` or `inactive`).
- `unique_groups` (Boolean) Whether **unique groups** are used.
